search_window.basis: Authenticated preceding watch heartbeat. Include materially new or newly discovered follow-ups absent from prior heartbeat, flagging publication-time uncertainty and possible retrospective discovery.

findings.title: Israeli airstrike kills 6 Palestinians at Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza
findings.location: Nasser Medical Complex, Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Patients, hospital staff and surgical/intensive-care services at Nasser Medical Complex; precise civilian/combatant status of casualties unverified
findings.supporting_passage: An Israeli airstrike killed six Palestinians and wounded more than 20 others at Nasser Medical Complex in southern Gaza early Thursday, Gaza’s Civil Defense said.
findings.source_type: Established wire agency citing Gaza Civil Defence and the hospital director
findings.confidence: medium-high (attributed six-death count corroborated by Al Jazeera; independent casualty verification unavailable)
findings.newly_verified_change: Six deaths and more than 20 injured, revised from five deaths and 20 injured in previous watch; same single strike, NOT six additional deaths. Hospital director also described ICU and surgical ward damage, previously known.

bounded_discovery_context.prior_watch_recorded: Five deaths, 20 injured, surgery and intensive-care damage at the same Nasser Hospital strike
bounded_discovery_context.materially_new_detail: One additional death in the reported total (five to six), and higher reported injury floor (>20 versus 20)
bounded_discovery_context.temporal_caveat: An Israel-time 03:32 November 12 liveblog entry referring to six deaths corresponds to 17:32 PST November 11, ten minutes before the preceding heartbeat finished. This is a retrospectively detected, previously missed material follow-up, NOT proof it was first published in the present observation window.
bounded_discovery_context.operational_status_caveat: A secondary report attributes a surgical-ward operations shutdown to Al Jazeera, but the primary text located did not independently verify service stoppage; no confirmed shutdown recorded.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary Gaza recall watch; production publisher/collector remains authoritative.
